rationale: All runs are feasible with wide margins; only setup matters. Raising both repair margins to 0.4 cut T_eff 8.06 -> 7.893, roughly one-for-one, so the best config is aim-limited: repair reaches target-minus-margin and signoff lands ~0.2 ns better. Target and margins are now at their limits, so the lever left is that offset, and the floorplan moves it: packing tighter (util 40, density 55%) cut it to -0.06 (8.149, 17 slew/cap pins), while md5 at 41% density had the largest offset. Both settings keep the best run and loosen placement: setting 1 lowers density to 39% at util 27; setting 2 also enlarges the die (util 22, density 35%) to map the trend.
